discovered: GAMEMODE_TREE_RANDOMIZER = Tech and Civic Shuffle Mode
sanity_check.discrepancies: No discrepancy in COUNT (8==8). ID-vs-familiar-name mapping required: expected 'Tech/Civic Shuffle' == discovered GAMEMODE_TREE_RANDOMIZER ('Tech and Civic Shuffle Mode'); expected 'Zombie Defense' == discovered GAMEMODE_TOWERDEFENSE ('Zombie Defense Mode'); expected 'Heroes & Legends' == GAMEMODE_HEROES ('Heroes & Legends Mode'); expected 'Monopolies & Corporations' == GAMEMODE_MONOPOLIES ('Monopolies and Corporations Mode'). No additional GAMEMODE_* ConfigurationId found in criteria scan; GAMEMODE_RANDOM is a pseudo-config (visibility gating, NotEquals per mode) not a playable mode; GAMEMODE_BARBARIANCLANS (no underscore) is an icon-reference string only, not a ConfigurationId.

discovery_method: Mechanically enumerated all 42 .modinfo under Base/+DLC/; parsed ActionCriteria + FrontEnd/InGame actions; harvested GAMEMODE_* tokens from criteria ConfigurationValueMatches (8 distinct playable IDs); cross-confirmed each ID has exactly one *ConfigData.xml defining a bool SetupParameter (Domain=bool DefaultValue=0 ConfigurationGroup=Game ConfigurationId=GAMEMODE_* GroupId=GameModes) plus a GameModes art/name row; friendly names resolved from en_US *ConfigText.xml LOC__NAME rows; overlays = all InGameActions whose resolved criteria JSON contains the mode id (joint-mode criteria attributed to both modes); SHA-256 per file resolved relative to owning modinfo dir. Row parser handles both attribute-style () and element-style (x) official rows; modifier triples join attachments to overlay-local ModifierArguments, falling back to a core index (Base/Assets/Gameplay/Data + Expansion1/Data + Expansion2/Data, 2705 ModifierIds) with provenance in triple[3] (overlay-local|core:|unresolved).
